_comment: Single source of truth for account-wide/cross-environment constants. Read by Terraform (via jsondecode(file(...)) in each root's main.tf) and by GitHub Actions (via the 'Load infra config' step in .github/workflows/*.yml, which parses this file with jq into $GITHUB_ENV). Do not hardcode these values anywhere else -- update them here only. See infra/bootstrap/backend.tf and infra/envs/*/backend.tf for the one documented exception (Terraform 'backend' blocks cannot reference variables/locals/functions, so tf_state_bucket must also be copied literally there; scripts/check-infra-config.sh enforces that those literals stay in sync with this file).
